homecoming.instructions: Official school homecoming, HOCO, alumni reunion or explicitly associated campus spirit celebrations. Include a varsity game only when the source explicitly associates it with homecoming. A regular game or unrelated party does not qualify.

holidays.instructions: Campus or student-community events explicitly themed around a named holiday, such as Halloween, Thanksgiving, Friendsgiving or winter holidays. A break in classes or a date near a holiday alone does not qualify. Follow the school-specific country and cultural context.

orientation.instructions: New-student orientation, frosh, O-Week or explicitly designated beginning-of-term orientation/welcome programming. An ordinary club meeting, recruitment drive or generic party does not qualify without orientation or welcome-week context.

midterm_prep.instructions: Study sessions, tutoring, review workshops or practice tests explicitly preparing for midterm exams. General academic talks and ordinary classes do not qualify.

exam_destress.instructions: Wellness, therapy animals, snack breaks, crafts or relaxation explicitly intended to ease midterm/final exam stress. Ordinary free food or wellness events do not qualify without an exam connection.

finals_prep.instructions: Review sessions, study groups, tutoring, practice exams or exam-skills workshops explicitly preparing for final exams. General academic talks, midterm preparation and ordinary classes do not qualify.

thanksgiving.instructions: Thanksgiving and Friendsgiving celebrations in the school-specific display window.

halloween.instructions: Halloween celebrations in the school-specific display window.

winter_holidays.instructions: Winter holiday celebrations in the school-specific display window.
